entry.title: DUNE construction
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. Construction of the Long-Baseline Neutrino Facility, which supports DUNE, is entering its next phase, with critical components arriving and partner institutions contributing. Separately, UK teams have completed half of the 137 Anode Plane Assemblies, the sensors that will detect the electrical signals from neutrino interactions in liquid argon.

entry.title: KM3NeT and gravitational waves
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. KM3NeT published a paper describing searches for coincident gravitational waves and high-energy neutrinos, using KM3NeT and ANTARES data from the O3 observing run. The motivation given is that gravitational-wave sources may produce high-energy neutrinos. The record does not state the outcome of the search.

entry.title: KM3-230213A review
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. A review summarises the properties of the ultra-high-energy event KM3-230213A, with an inferred parent-neutrino energy of order 10^17 eV. It discusses interpretations in terms of active galactic nuclei, transient sources and cosmogenic neutrinos. Despite extensive follow-up, no unambiguous electromagnetic counterpart has been found.

entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. The IceCube winter-over team reported detector maintenance and troubleshooting, including a replaced hard drive and software updates, with calibration work under way on the Upgrade. The station also celebrated the award of the Nobel Prize in Physics to IceCube PI Francis Halzen.

entry.title: Auger sterile search
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. The Pierre Auger Collaboration studied its sensitivity to sterile neutrinos with masses between MeV and 100 MeV, in a 3+1 framework with mixing mainly to the tau flavour. Such neutrinos could cross long chords of the Earth and produce tau leptons that decay in the atmosphere, generating detectable air showers. Exposures are computed with a detailed Monte Carlo simulation.

entry.title: nEXO backgrounds
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. A simulation study estimates the cosmogenic background for nEXO, a five-tonne liquid-xenon time projection chamber for neutrinoless double beta decay in 136Xe, at its preferred host site, SNOLAB. It compares Geant4 and FLUKA muon simulations.

entry.title: Project 8 dissociator
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. Project 8 aims at a model-independent neutrino mass measurement through cyclotron radiation emission spectroscopy of tritium beta decay, with a sensitivity goal of 40 meV/c^2. A new paper reports a prototype electron cyclotron resonance dissociator that ignites a hydrogen plasma for the planned atomic-tritium beamline.

entry.title: CMS heavy neutral leptons
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. CMS reported two searches for heavy neutral leptons. One targets a Majorana state in top-quark decays with same-sign, same-flavour dilepton final states, using 138 fb^-1 at 13 TeV. The other looks for long-lived states in W decays with a prompt muon and a displaced vertex of two muons, using 138 fb^-1 at 13 TeV and 34.6 fb^-1 at 13.6 TeV.

entry.title: The paper computes the neutrino emissivity of Δ-direct-Urca processes in neutron stars, which had not been exp
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. The paper computes the neutrino emissivity of Δ-direct-Urca processes in neutron stars, which had not been explicitly evaluated even though Δ isobars are proposed to exist in dense cores. It matters for neutron-star cooling, where Urca processes are the dominant neutrino-emitting mechanisms.

entry.title: The authors study what kiloton-scale detectors such as Hyper-Kamiokande can learn about the primary cosmic-ray
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. The authors study what kiloton-scale detectors such as Hyper-Kamiokande can learn about the primary cosmic-ray spectrum from atmospheric neutrinos. They find that future detectors can distinguish cosmic-ray models with high statistical significance, even with cross-section and hadronic-interaction uncertainties.

entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. Motivated by updated IceCube data for NGC 1068 down to about 0.2 TeV, the paper infers the conditions for neutrino production from hadronic channels and accompanying cascade gamma rays. It uses Latin hypercube sampling to explore the parameter space, constrained by multimessenger observations.

entry.title: The paper proves a no-go theorem: open two-flavour oscillation evolutions covariant under rotations of the mas
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. The paper proves a no-go theorem: open two-flavour oscillation evolutions covariant under rotations of the mass-coherence plane are exactly blind to a Majorana phase. A rate anisotropy can supply an environmental phase reference, which sets when decoherence could reveal the phase.

entry.title: Using low-energy solar neutrino-electron scattering data from PandaX-4T and XENONnT, the paper derives exclusi
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. Using low-energy solar neutrino-electron scattering data from PandaX-4T and XENONnT, the paper derives exclusion limits on anomaly-free U(1)_X dark photon models with kinetic and mass mixing. The strength of the limits correlates with the leptonic charge assignments of each of six benchmark models.

entry.title: The paper studies neutrino mass and thermal leptogenesis in the Babu-Nandi-Tavartkiladze model, where neutrino
entry.summary: AI-generated summary of the linked source; may contain errors. The paper studies neutrino mass and thermal leptogenesis in the Babu-Nandi-Tavartkiladze model, where neutrino masses arise from a dimension-7 operator at tree level and a dimension-5 operator at one loop. The model accommodates sub-eV neutrino masses with new physics at the TeV scale, and leptogenesis here differs from the canonical seesaw case.
